verdict.rationale: Gitea is documented as a self-hosted Git service. Community users deploy it as a Git server for teams, contrast cloning with browsing in the web UI, and mirror repositories. The Git LFS docs reference standard Git client versions, which implies ordinary Git clients work against it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of clone/pull/push over HTTPS and over SSH, and hands-on confirmation of both transport protocols with standard Git clients.
